title: Fajr prayer
intro: The morning prayer: 2 rak‘ahs sunnah and 2 rak‘ahs fard.

learn.html: Fajr is the morning prayer, prayed from dawn until sunrise. It has four rak‘ahs: two rak‘ahs sunnah and two rak‘ahs fard. After getting ready for Salah we say A‘udhu billah and Bismillah, then the niyyah.

learn.title: 📖 In the Qur’an
learn.html: Luqman said to his son: O my son, establish the prayer! <small>(Qur’an, Luqman 31:17)</small>

learn.label: Niyyah for the sunnah of Fajr
learn.ar: نَوَيْتُ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى صَلَاةَ سُنَّةِ الْفَجْرِ أَدَاءً مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبْلَةِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
learn.tr: Nawaytu an usalliya lillaahi ta‘aalaa salaata sunnatil-fajri, adaa’an mustaqbilal-qiblati. Allaahu akbar!
learn.en: I intend to pray, for Allah, the sunnah of Fajr, on time, facing the Qiblah. Allah is the Greatest!

learn.label: Niyyah for the fard of Fajr
learn.ar: نَوَيْتُ أَنْ أُصَلِّيَ لِلَّهِ تَعَالَى صَلَاةَ فَرْضِ الْفَجْرِ أَدَاءً مُسْتَقْبِلَ الْقِبْلَةِ، اللَّهُ أَكْبَرُ
learn.tr: Nawaytu an usalliya lillaahi ta‘aalaa salaata fardil-fajri, adaa’an mustaqbilal-qiblati. Allaahu akbar!
learn.en: I intend to pray, for Allah, the fard of Fajr, on time, facing the Qiblah. Allah is the Greatest!

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: We pray the sunnah and the fard of Fajr the same way – two rak‘ahs each.
Practise: Let’s pray two rak‘ahs and Build the Salah – level 1.
